title: NCRPO to go on full alert Saturday; over 15,000 cops to secure Sept. 21 protests

blocks.text: The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) will be placed under full alert status beginning Saturday as authorities prepare for expected protests in Metro Manila on Sept. 21, which marks the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law.
